name: jarvis
description: Assistente de voz em tempo real com a OpenAI Realtime API (WebRTC).

scripts.helper: mkdir -p bin && swiftc -O -parse-as-library native/jarvis-helper.swift native/wake.swift -o bin/jarvis-helper -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker native/Info.plist
